title: LLRP: Add support for ImpinjRFDopplerFrequency parameter
description:
Support for this parameter is expected, because ImpinjEnableRFDopplerFrequency is already supported. The changes are very simple - same principle as with ImpinjEnableRFPhaseAngle and ImpinjRFPhaseAngle parameters which were already supported in the first place.

The changes only encompass 1 file: epan/dissectors/packet-llrp.c

Without those changes, Impinj UHF RFID readers that are configured to use Impinj-specific extensions and to report the Doppler frequency parameter have their PDUs marked as malformed by Wireshark. 

See GUI before & after changes.
Before:
![image](/uploads/33fe33df2c173ae0aeebac7092473e53/image.png){width=900 height=248}
After:
![image](/uploads/ce65f7904289db9529558e98007b1531/image.png){width=900 height=197}

LLRP communication pcap (See the LLRP message no 45 (RO Access Report)): [llrp_impinj_doppler_param.pcapng](/uploads/3196947587b91812addcf01dd61f274e/llrp_impinj_doppler_param.pcapng)

please ensure to keep this array sorted by increasing value: this line should go after LLRP_IMPINJ_PARAM_ENABLE_RF_DOPPLER_FREQ entry

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22212/diffs?diff_id=1556943166&start_sha=f743f0bc2ddd160c7fd65f98c9e67603b1bd22c1#36e07a9173af28d4bacb0b46d1a0c3ed7dc423d7_1064_1064)
I opened https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22216 - they may be arguments for and against (generally) keeping the entries in order.

Regarding https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22216, and the "parameters may be out of order in the spec" argument:

The Impinj Octane LLRP Guide which defines those custom parameter subtype values (that are present in the mentioned`impinj_param_type` array) are indeed defined out of order in the spec (across various versions of the spec including the latest v7.6 one at https://support.impinj.com/hc/article_attachments/33622715875475), so keeping them in order does require some additional manual work when extending the custom parameter support (though it's not very painful). The existing definitions in the epan/dissectors/packet-llrp.c file are in order, but that can be refactored. The decision whether that shall be changed is up to the team. You can let me know if I should update this MR.

Btw there are more parameters that are defined by Impinj specs, but are not supported in packet-llrp.c. Shall we add them to this MR or let's do that later in a separate PR?

impinj_param_type_ext array mandates to have values by increasing order, that's why I asked you to change it.
Given that this MR is ready to merge (as soon as the MAC OS builder is back alive) I suggest you to create a follow up MR if required.
